# Civic Safety Advisors

> Security consulting firm in Branford, Connecticut, founded by Seth Hershman, a former Yale University Police detective and Connecticut DESPP policy advisor. We assess risk, write emergency plans, and train staff for houses of worship, schools, property managers, nonprofits, and public organizations in Connecticut, New York, Massachusetts, and Rhode Island. We do not sell guards, cameras, or alarm systems.

Phone: (203) 676-8193. Email: info@civicsafetyadvisors.com.

## Key pages
- [Free Security Self-Assessment](https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/assessment): 20-minute self-assessment that scores eight security areas and returns a prioritized action list and PDF. Start at https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/assessment/start.
- [Connecticut Nonprofit Security Grant Program guide](https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/connecticut-nonprofit-security-grant): federal NSGP and state CT-NSGP eligibility, deadlines, the required vulnerability assessment, and allowable costs.
- [Services](https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/services): threat and vulnerability assessments, workplace violence and employee safety assessments, policy review, emergency response plans, safety team and staff training.
- [Industries](https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/industries): houses of worship, schools, property management and housing providers, nonprofits and public organizations.
  - [Houses of worship](https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/industries/houses-of-worship)
  - [Schools and colleges](https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/industries/schools-education)
  - [Property managers and housing providers](https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/industries/property-management-housing)
  - [Nonprofits and public organizations](https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/industries/nonprofits-public-organizations)
- [About](https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/about): Seth Hershman's background and the firm's approach.
- [Blog](https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/blog): practical guidance on security planning.
- [Contact](https://www.civicsafetyadvisors.com/contact)

## Facts
- Location: Branford, Connecticut. Service area: CT, NY, MA, RI; virtual consulting elsewhere in the United States.
- Founder: Seth Hershman. Six-plus years with the Yale University Police Department (patrol officer to detective), then policy work at the Connecticut Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection. M.S. in Investigations, University of New Haven, 2024.
- Vendor-neutral: recommendations are not tied to the sale of equipment or guard contracts.
